physics-h3-q1.title: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale
physics-h3-q1.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h3-q1.material: Kedu nsonaazụ nke nnwale photoelectric effect nke Einstein enweghị ike ikwu site na 'echiche ebili mmiri nke ìhè' ma 'echiche photon (akụkụ) nke ìhè' naanị na-akọwa ya kpamkpam?

physics-h3-q2.title: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere
physics-h3-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h3-q2.material: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
physics-h3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Akụkụ nwere ụgwọ nwere ibu m na ụgwọ q na-abata n'ụzọ kwụ ọtọ n'ime ikpo magnet edoro anya B n'ọsọ v ma na-eme mmegharị gburugburu edoro anya. Kedu nhọrọ na-egosi nke ọma radius r na period T nke ụzọ gburugburu ya?
physics-h3-q2.s.s1.explain: Site na nha ike centripetal, $\frac{mv^2}{r} = qvB \implies r = \frac{mv}{qB}$. Period bụ $T = \frac{2\pi r}{v} = \frac{2\pi m}{qB}$, ma n'ụzọ na-eju anya, cyclotron period a adabereghị na radius ụzọ ma ọ bụ ọsọ.

physics-h3-q2.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.

physics-h3-q3.title: N'ụdị Bohr nke atom
physics-h3-q3.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h3-q3.material: N'ụdị Bohr nke atom hydrogen, kedu ọnọdụ ebili mmiri guzoro ziri ezi n'etiti ogologo ebili mmiri ihe (matter wave) λ nke electron na-agagharị n'ụzọ nwere nọmba quantum isi n na radius r nke ụzọ?

physics-h3-c.title: [Mechanics akụkụ abụọ miri
physics-h3-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-h3-c.material: [Mechanics akụkụ abụọ miri emi] Ebe kachasị larịị R nke ihe a gbapụrụ site n'ala n'akụkụ θ na larịị na ọsọ mbụ v₀ bụ R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Ọ bụrụ na enweghị ọgbụgba ikuku, kedu akụkụ ịgbapụ θ ebe larịị kacha ukwuu, na kedu akụkụ ịgbapụ ọzọ nwere otu ebe larịị dịka akụkụ ịgbapụ 30°, n'usoro?
physics-h3-c.s.s1.prompt: [Mechanics akụkụ abụọ miri emi] Ebe kachasị larịị R nke ihe a gbapụrụ site n'ala n'akụkụ θ na larịị na ọsọ mbụ v₀ bụ R = (v₀² sin 2θ) / g. Ọ bụrụ na enweghị ọgbụgba ikuku, kedu akụkụ ịgbapụ θ ebe larịị kacha ukwuu, na kedu akụkụ ịgbapụ ọzọ nwere otu ebe larịị dịka akụkụ ịgbapụ 30°, n'usoro?

physics-killer-12.title: N'elu larịị e tinyere
physics-killer-12.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
physics-killer-12.material: N'elu larịị e tinyere ndọrọ ígwè abụọ na-eduzi eletrik na-edoghị anya, nha n'etiti ha $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, a jikọkwara otu ọnụ na resistor. Nguzogide niile nke okirikiri mejupụtara ndọrọ ígwè, mkpanaka ígwè na-eduzi eletrik, na resistor bụ $2\,\Omega$. Ikpo magnet edoro anya kwụ ọtọ $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ kpuchiri okirikiri niile, ma mkpanaka na-aga n'elu ndọrọ ígwè n'ọsọ edoro anya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ n'ntụziaka na-apụ site na resistor. N'ime $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ mkpanaka ahụ gagoro $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux na-agafe okirikiri na-agbanwe site na $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ike ọkụ e kpatara na-asọ n'okirikiri, na ịdị ukwuu ike mpụga achọrọ iji debe mkpanaka n'ọsọ edoro anya? (Enweghị esemokwu.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.prompt: N'elu larịị e tinyere ndọrọ ígwè abụọ na-eduzi eletrik na-edoghị anya, nha n'etiti ha $\ell=0.5\,\mathrm{m}$, a jikọkwara otu ọnụ na resistor. Nguzogide niile nke okirikiri mejupụtara ndọrọ ígwè, mkpanaka ígwè na-eduzi eletrik, na resistor bụ $2\,\Omega$. Ikpo magnet edoro anya kwụ ọtọ $B=0.5\,\mathrm{T}$ kpuchiri okirikiri niile, ma mkpanaka na-aga n'elu ndọrọ ígwè n'ọsọ edoro anya $4\,\mathrm{m/s}$ n'ntụziaka na-apụ site na resistor. N'ime $0.5\,\mathrm{s}$ mkpanaka ahụ gagoro $2\,\mathrm{m}$, magnetic flux na-agafe okirikiri na-agbanwe site na $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x$. Kedu nhọrọ na-ejikọta nke ọma, n'usoro, ike ọkụ e kpatara na-asọ n'okirikiri, na ịdị ukwuu ike mpụga achọrọ iji debe mkpanaka n'ọsọ edoro anya? (Enweghị esemokwu.)
physics-killer-12.s.s1.explain: $\Delta\Phi=B\ell\Delta x=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot2=0.5\,\mathrm{Wb}$, $|\mathcal E|=\dfrac{\Delta\Phi}{\Delta t}=\dfrac{0.5}{0.5}=1.0\,\mathrm{V}$ ($=B\ell v=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot4$, ha kwekọrọ). $I=\dfrac{\mathcal E}{R}=\dfrac{1.0}{2}=0.5\,\mathrm{A}$. Ike magnet mkpanaka na-enweta $F=BI\ell=0.5\cdot0.5\cdot0.5=0.125\,\mathrm{N}$ (n'ntụziaka na-egbochi mmegharị dabere n'iwu Lenz) ma ebe ọsọ edoro anya, ike mpụga bụkwa $0.125\,\mathrm{N}$. Nyocha: ike ọrụ mpụga $Fv=0.125\cdot4=0.5\,\mathrm{W}=I^2R=0.25\cdot2$. Ọ bụrụ na e hapụ $\ell$, $I=1.0\,\mathrm{A}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ①); ọ bụrụ na e hapụ $\ell$ n'ọgbakọ ike, $0.25\,\mathrm{N}$ (azịza na-ezighị ezi ②); njehie ịmụba $\mathcal E$ site na $\frac12$ bụ azịza na-ezighị ezi ④.
physics-killer-12.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-12.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
